es: Responder una pregunta de conducta con situación, acción, resultado y lección, y una hipotética con would, un motivo y un ejemplo.

teaching.en: When the club lost its hall, I took the initiative and asked the library for a room.
teaching.es: Cuando el club perdió su sala, tomé la iniciativa y pedí una sala a la biblioteca.
teaching.explanationEs: Respuesta de conducta: situación y acción en pasado simple (lost, asked).
segments: When the club lost its hall, I took the
initiative and asked the library for a room.
teaching.audioText: When the club lost its hall, I took the initiative and asked the library for a room.

teaching.en: I can handle complaints because I have done it before: I worked at the school shop for a year.
teaching.es: Sé gestionar quejas porque ya lo he hecho: trabajé un año en la tienda del colegio.
teaching.explanationEs: Present perfect (have done) para la experiencia general; pasado simple para el detalle (worked).
segments: I can handle complaints because I have done it before:
I worked at the school shop for a year.
teaching.audioText: I can handle complaints because I have done it before: I worked at the school shop for a year.

teaching.en: As a result, the club kept its Tuesday meetings, and that was the outcome I wanted.
teaching.es: Como resultado, el club mantuvo sus reuniones de los martes, y ese era el resultado que quería.
teaching.explanationEs: As a result + pasado: cierra la historia con su efecto.
segments: As a result, the club kept its Tuesday
meetings, and that was the outcome I wanted.
teaching.audioText: As a result, the club kept its Tuesday meetings, and that was the outcome I wanted.

teaching.en: That experience taught me an important lesson: ask early, and people help.
teaching.es: Esa experiencia me enseñó una lección importante: pide ayuda pronto y la gente ayuda.
teaching.explanationEs: Taught me a lesson: la enseñanza cierra la respuesta de conducta.
segments: That experience taught me an important
lesson: ask early, and people help.
teaching.audioText: That experience taught me an important lesson: ask early, and people help.

teaching.en: In that case, I would speak to the leader first, and then I would ask the team for evidence.
teaching.es: En ese caso, hablaría primero con el líder y luego pediría pruebas al equipo.
teaching.explanationEs: Hipótesis: would + verbo base; se responde con una decisión y su razón.
segments: In that case, I would speak to the leader first,
and then I would ask the team for evidence.
teaching.audioText: In that case, I would speak to the leader first, and then I would ask the team for evidence.

teaching.en: It would depend on the problem, but I would always handle it calmly.
teaching.es: Dependería del problema, pero siempre lo gestionaría con calma.
teaching.explanationEs: It would depend on… es la salida honesta cuando faltan datos en una pregunta hipotética.
segments: It would depend on the problem, but
I would always handle it calmly.
teaching.audioText: It would depend on the problem, but I would always handle it calmly.

prompt.es: Completa: «Cuando el club perdió su sala, tomé la iniciativa.»

feedback.es: Take the initiative es actuar por cuenta propia, sin esperar a que te lo pidan.

hint.es: Es el nombre de actuar por cuenta propia.

origin.text: When the club lost its hall, I took the ___.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cierra bien una respuesta de conducta?

choices.text: I am a very responsible and organised person.
I would ask for help if there was a problem.
As a result, we kept the hall, and I learned to ask early.

feedback.es: Una respuesta de conducta termina con resultado y aprendizaje. Las otras dos dan un adjetivo sin ejemplo o pasan a una hipótesis.

hint.es: Busca resultado y aprendizaje, no una cualidad sin ejemplo.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Como resultado, el club mantuvo sus reuniones.»

answer.text: As a result the club kept its meetings

feedback.es: As a result + sujeto + pasado cierra la historia con su efecto.

hint.es: Empieza con as a result y sigue con sujeto + pasado.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta a la pregunta hipotética es correcta?

choices.text: I would speak to my teammate first and offer help.
I will speak to my teammate first and offer help.
I spoke to my teammate first and offered help.

feedback.es: Una pregunta con would… if pide una decisión con would + verbo base. Will y el pasado no responden a la hipótesis.

origin.text: Question: What would you do if a teammate missed a deadline?

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el resultado de la historia.

choices.text: They sold fewer books than planned.
They could buy furniture for the library.

feedback.es: Como resultado de la venta, compraron una estantería nueva para la biblioteca.

origin.audio: Last year I organised a book sale at school. We sold two hundred books, and as a result, we bought a new shelf for the library.

feedback.es: La experiencia general, sin fecha, se cuenta con present perfect: I have handled.

prompt.es: Escribe dos respuestas: una de conducta y una hipotética.

answer.text: Last year, our school football team had no coach, so I took the initiative. I asked a teacher for help, and I organised the timetable for all the players. As a result, the team played every match, and I learned that asking for help early solves problems. If a volunteer did not come to an event, I would speak to that person first, because I would want to understand what happened. Then I would find another volunteer, so the event could start on time and the guests would not notice the problem. It would depend on the reason, but I would always stay calm and handle the situation politely.
accepted: Last year, our school football team had no coach, so I took the initiative. I asked a teacher for help, and I organised the timetable for all the players. As a result, the team played every match, and I learned that asking for help early solves problems. If a volunteer did not come to an event, I would speak to that person first, because I would want to understand what happened. Then I would find another volunteer, so the event could start on time and the guests would not notice the problem. It would depend on the reason, but I would always stay calm and handle the situation politely.

Last year, the football team at my school had no coach, so I took the initiative and asked a teacher to help us. I also made a timetable for the players. As a result, we played every match, and that experience taught me a lesson: it is better to ask for help early. In the second case, if a volunteer did not come to an event, I would call that person first to find out what happened. In that case, I would ask someone else to take the place, so the event could start on time and the guests would not notice the problem. It would depend on the reason, but I would handle it calmly.

feedback.es: Una buena respuesta de conducta cuenta situación, acción, resultado y lección; la hipotética da una decisión con would, un motivo y una salida honesta con it would depend.

origin.text: Preguntas de una entrevista de voluntariado. 1) «Tell me about a time when you solved a problem in a group.» Datos: el año pasado el equipo de fútbol de tu colegio no tenía entrenador; pediste ayuda a un profesor y organizaste los horarios; resultado: el equipo jugó todos los partidos; aprendiste que pedir ayuda pronto resuelve problemas. 2) «What would you do if a volunteer did not come to an event?» Responde con would: hablarías primero con esa persona, buscarías a otro voluntario y dependería del motivo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la lección de la respuesta.

choices.text: A shop must always have bread.
Listening first helps to solve a problem.

feedback.es: La persona escuchó primero, ofreció otra cosa y el cliente se calmó: la lección es que escuchar antes ayuda a resolver.

origin.audio: Tell me about a time when you handled a difficult situation. Well, last summer a customer was angry because the shop had no bread. I listened, offered another product, and he thanked me. I learned that listening first works.

feedback.es: Lesson cierra la historia con la enseñanza, as a result introduce el efecto y it would depend abre una respuesta hipotética prudente.

sentences: That experience taught me an important ___.
___ a result, we played every match.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si un voluntario no viniera, hablaría con él primero.»

answer.text: If a volunteer did not come I would speak to him first

feedback.es: Hipótesis: if + pasado (did not come) y would + verbo base (would speak).

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta tiene situación, acción y resultado?

choices.text: Last May I had three exams in one week, so I made a plan. As a result, I passed all of them.
I am always calm under pressure because I am strong.
I would make a plan if I had three exams in one week.

feedback.es: Solo esta respuesta cuenta un hecho con acción (I made a plan) y resultado (I passed). Las otras dan una cualidad o una hipótesis.

origin.text: Question: Tell me about a time when you worked under pressure.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué haría la persona primero.

choices.text: Explain the limits of the project.

feedback.es: Primero explicaría los límites y después ofrecería un cambio menor. No rechaza ni acepta de inmediato.

origin.audio: What would you do if a client asked for a change on the last day? Well, it would depend, but I would explain the limits first, and then I would offer a smaller change.

prompt.es: Escribe la frase de resultado de tu historia.

answer.text: As a result, the group finished on time, and I learned to plan.
accepted: As a result, the group finished on time, and I learned to plan.
As a result, we finished on time, and I learned to make a plan.
As a result, the group finished on time, and I have learned to plan.

feedback.es: La frase de resultado enlaza la acción con su efecto (as a result) y termina con una lección personal.

origin.text: Cuenta el resultado: como resultado, el grupo terminó a tiempo y tú aprendiste a planificar.
